_source: Authored from jobs/messner_site/asbuilt.json (the as-built model). The engine's frame: x along the house, left to right standing in the yard facing the house (south at x = 0, north on the right — asbuilt x mirrored, x = 615" - x_asbuilt); y out from the house. The job-local fields (fascia posts, glass, vertical cable, ties, braces as built, (V) items, notes) are read by jobs/messner_site/tooling/messner_ext.py; the engine ignores them.

facts._about: The deck as built, in the words every sheet uses (from asbuilt.json and the photo inventory). (V) = field-verify. Datum: z = 0 at the outer-row (B2) grade, so geometry.height_in (161") is the surface over that grade; elevations in inches from it, y in inches out from the house face.
facts.height: Deck surface ~10'-9" over the inner-row (B1) pier tops and ~12'-9" over the outer-row (B2) pier tops (V)
facts.grade: Grade falls away from the house: ~2' between the pier rows; the stair's lower flight lands near the house on a PT plank (V)

retaining_wall.words: ~3' timber retaining wall just outboard of the outer piers (seen; location and height (V))

facts.house: The main floor cantilevers ~2'-9" (V) past the basement wall below (house sheets A-1.10); a soffit runs under the ledger
facts.ledger: 2x12 ledger (V) to the main-floor band: 1/2"-5/8" bolts or lags (V) with ~2-1/2" sq. plate washers, about one per joist bay (~16" o.c.) (V)
facts.ledger_flashing: Flashing: not visible — verify (V); CWUIC 504.7.3.1 6" vertical metal flashing at the deck-to-wall line (V)
facts.ledger_support: Ledger on the cantilevered main-floor band (V) — engineered (CRC R507.9.1.2 / R301.1.3)
facts.footings: Existing round concrete piers ~12-14" dia., 4-12" above grade, cast-in CBSQ66-type bases; footing size and depth (V) (2018 design: 12" Quik-Tube pier on a 15" sq x 12" footing, 36" min. into competent bearing)
facts.post_base: Cast-in standoff post base, black-painted (CBSQ66-type): (14) 1/4" x 2" SDS per the catalog — model and screws (V)
facts.posts: 14 6x6 PT posts in two rows of 7: ~9' (inner row, B1) and ~11' (outer row, B2) (V); stations estimated ~90" o.c. (V)
facts.post_caps: Post cap: black-painted plate with galvanized legs on the post (CCQ/ECCQ-type) — model and fasteners (V)
facts.beams: 6x12 solid-sawn drop beams B1 (~87" from the house) and B2 (~172") (V); PT DF or redwood (V); every splice over a post (V)
facts.joists: 2x10 PT DF joists @ 16" o.c. (grade stamp (V)); Simpson LUS210Z at every joist at the ledger
facts.header: B1: the house-side joists hang from a continuous header on the beam (LUS-type hangers; A35 / LTP4-type clips header to beam, ~1 per bay)
facts.rims: Single 2x10 rim; PVC fascia over it, two boards high, face-fastened
facts.joist_ties: Simpson H2.5A at each joist on the outer beam B2 (~10 seen; count (V)): (10) 0.131" x 2-1/2" nails per the catalog
facts.lateral_ties: Simpson DTT2Z: 1 confirmed (IMG_5677, ~30-35 ft from the north end (V)); total count and locations (V); CRC R507.9.2: 2 x 1,500 lb within 24" of each end
facts.lateral_tie_fastening: (8) 1/4" x 1-1/2" SDS into the joist + a 1/2" threaded rod or bolt through the ledger and band (catalog); the anchorage inside (V)
facts.knee_braces: 6x6 knee braces at 45° in the planes of the beams: B2 — singles at both end posts + Y-braces at posts 2, 4 and 6; B1 — one at the south end post
facts.knee_brace_ends: Knee-brace end connections: not visible (V) — per the engineer of record
facts.blocking: Solid 2x10 blocking over both beams + one continuous row at mid-span of the house-side bay (as seen)
facts.guard_blocking: Blocking behind the rim at each guard post: not visible (V)
facts.decking: TimberTech Vintage Weathered Teak (5.5" PVC boards), parallel to the house
facts.fascia: PVC fascia over the rim, two boards high, face-fastened
facts.guard: Black aluminum guard, IRX-type (system and part numbers (V)): fascia-mounted posts ~5-6' o.c., top rail, bottom channel, clear glass infill, 42"
facts.guard_bracket: Fascia bracket (U-cup with side flanges): (2) galvanized hex lags + washers per flange through the PVC fascia into the rim, as seen; an engineered connection on wood (ESR-4217 covers the bracket on concrete only)
facts.stairs: Stair to the lower yard: 16 risers ~6-5/8" (11 + 5), 14 treads ~11-1/2"; ~3' wide and a ~3' x 3' landing on 4 posts (V)
facts.stringers: 3 stringers per flight: a notched 3x center stringer + 2 solid outer stringers
facts.stair_connectors: Simpson LSCZ-type stringer connectors at the deck header: 2 seen (V)
facts.tread_angles: TA-type tread angles on the outer stringers, every step
facts.stair_base: Lower flight bears on a PT plank at grade (V) — no concrete pad
facts.stair_guard: Stair and landing guards: black aluminum posts and top rail, vertical stainless cable ~3-1/4" o.c. (V); ~38" over the nosings (V); landing guard height (V)
facts.handrail: Round black graspable handrail on one side of each flight, looped returns
